_about: Independent, known-conformant UCP servers the differential gate (differential.py) runs the suite against, to catch checks that pass our own fixture but false-flag a server we did NOT author (the fixture-circularity risk). URLs are resolved from an environment variable (server_env) so real endpoints/secrets are never committed. The gate SKIPs cleanly when none are reachable, and also accepts an ad-hoc --server on the command line. Add your own conformant staging server here to keep the suite honest against a second implementation.

targets.name: flower-shop-official-sample
targets.note: The official UCP Flower Shop sample server — an implementation independent of our controlled fixture. Served locally by conformance/ci/serve_golden.sh. As of the 2026-07-31 re-pin it serves spec version 2026-04-08 (it served 2026-01-23 under the previous pin), so this target now exercises the 04-08 lane. Set UCP_FLOWER_SHOP_URL to its base URL to include it.

targets.name: nodejs-reference-sample
targets.note: The official UCP Node.js reference server (samples/rest/nodejs — a Hono + Zod + @ucp-js/sdk app), a SECOND independent implementation whose author is not us AND not the Python golden. It advertises spec 2026-04-08 (src/utils/config.ts UCP_VERSION), so it exercises the 04-08 lane against a genuinely separate codebase, catching any check that quietly encoded Python-flower-specific behavior. History of healed deviations, all fixed upstream then expired out of differential_allowlist.json per its self-expiry contract: samples#168 (DISC-003 Cache-Control + PAY-003 payment_handlers, expired at the 2026-08-11 re-pin), OUR samples#174 (the flat-`detail` error-body class, 18 sites — CHK-050 protocol-error shape + CHK-053 unavailable-error envelope expired at the 2026-08-13 re-pin), OUR samples#187 (the last flat-detail site, testing.ts simulate-shipping order-not-found, in the 2026-08-19 pin). The allowlist is EMPTY — every check agrees with this target. As of the 2026-08-19 re-pin the sample also SIGNS order-event webhook deliveries per RFC 9421 (OUR samples#179) and retries failed deliveries (samples#175), so differential_nodejs.config.json runs with webhooks.signed/.retries ON — the signed/retry check cluster grades live here, exactly like the flower target since 08-13. (samples#162 had earlier added inbound signature VERIFICATION, enforced only when REQUIRE_SIGNATURES=true, so unsigned probes still pass.) Served locally by conformance/ci/serve_node_reference.sh (seeds the same flower catalog into its SQLite, boots via tsx on :3000). Set UCP_NODEJS_URL to its base URL to include it. NOTE the sample's own `npm run build && npm start` is broken (extensionless ESM imports — upstream samples#58, still reproducing); run it with tsx as the serve script does.
